Only the task's own work travels: the non-hidden entries in /root and /tmp/work, the outputs directory, and the working repository if one is mounted. - Task: what this thread is trying to achieve, in one paragraph.
- Decisions: the decisions already made, and why.
- In progress: the step you were in the middle of when this turn started.
- Open questions: what is unresolved or waiting on someone else.
- Files: every working file that matters, absolute path plus a one-line description of what it holds.

Step 2 - build the archive. The shell starts in /, and the archive must be written flat into the outputs directory. Run these three commands, in order, exactly as written:
  cd /
  mkdir -p /root/work /tmp/work
  find root mnt/session/outputs tmp/work -type f -size +20M > /tmp/daimon-handoff-excludes.txt
  tar czf /mnt/session/outputs/daimon-handoff-0f9d1c4e-7c2b-4f5a-9d3e-1b2c3d4e5f60.tar.gz \
    --exclude-from=/tmp/daimon-handoff-excludes.txt \
    --exclude='root/.*' \
    --exclude='tmp/work/.*' \
    --exclude='tmp/daimon-handoff-excludes.txt' \
    --exclude='mnt/session/outputs/daimon-handoff-*' \
    --exclude='mnt/session/uploads' \
    --exclude='mnt/memory' \
    --exclude='mnt/skills' \
    --exclude='*/.git/objects' \
    --exclude='*/node_modules' \
    --exclude='*/.venv' \
    --exclude='*/__pycache__' \
    --exclude='*/.cache' \
    --exclude='*.env' \
    -C / root mnt/session/outputs tmp/work
The find step lists files too large to carry so tar skips them; do not edit either command.

Step 3 - check the size, then show the result. Run:

The archive cannot be carried above 20 MiB, so that command deletes it and prints HANDOFF_TOO_LARGE instead. That is a complete answer: do not retry, shrink or rebuild it.

Step 4 - reply with the output of the commands above. A short note alongside it is fine; daimon reads the output, not the prose.
